data.name: Thorn Burst
data.description: As a swift action, you can cause sharp splinters of wood to explode outward from your body. These splinters deal %1d6 points of piercing damage to all creatures within a 10-foot burst. A Reflex save (DC %2) halves this damage. In addition, the sharp splinters count as caltrops (see page 155 of the Core Rulebook) in the area until your next turn. You can use this ability %3/day.|ThornBurstDice|ThornBurstDC|ThornBurstTimes
